newsitem.title: THAILAND: Senior Thai police officer held on murder charges.
newsitem.headline: Senior Thai police officer held on murder charges.

text.p: A senior police officer was detained on Tuesday on charges of murdering a taxi driver and the driver's year-old baby, police said on Tuesday.

Police said Captain Suthep Wisuma, chief of a traffic police precinct in a Bangkok suburb, had confessed to killing Chamroon Nuangchum, 30, and his year-old son and burning their bodies in a field in the outskirts of the capital.
Police found the charred bodies of Chamroon and his son early on Sunday morning, a day after Chamroon's wife told police the two were missing.
Police alleged that Suthep killed the two after discovering that Chamroon was having an affair with his mistress.
Suthep was detained pending formal charges. If found guilty he could face the death penalty.
